body:
Disparaging as it may be, this is imo semingly the best route we can take to fixing these issues. I would however recommend adding it directly at the `Container` level, i.e. like I did here whilst investigating the issue:
https://github.com/StarryWorm/godot/blob/4bfbd85415d7c9a38b8a91f4a743df7c44518732/scene/gui/container.cpp#L100-L102
This way, we ensure we cover cases for all `Container` types. 

Regarding your two concerns in the additional notes:
1. This is a quirk of the ordering of layout computations... The `TextureRect` is returning exactly what it should be returning based on the size it was given by its parent... which shouldn't have given it that size.
2. This is normal, otherwise we'd be absolutely drowning in size computation which would kill the performance of `Control` nodes.

I created a [gist with the logs](https://gist.github.com/StarryWorm/faae66e424e386f6f5ce7078303a6637) as produced using my branch (from which the code above comes, you can [use my fork's CI to get the build](https://github.com/StarryWorm/godot/actions/runs/30036629173) to test it yourself) with a slightly modified issue MRP to make the debug filtering easier (needed for logs to be produced using my fork), [box-container-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30319471/box-container-bug.zip). Looking at the latest revision, which covers the changes after adding the aforementioned calls to `Container`'s layout process, there is indeed a non-negligible increase in method calls. 
**I think this is a trade-off we have to take.** 

The whole size system could be optimized in future PRs to reduce unnecessary calls, which is something I have been considering for some time now. For example, looking at those logs, there are a lot of "BoxContainer  x  has computed minimum size" that aren't followed by "Control x is validating minimum size cache" which shouldn't be possible, since `Control::get_minimum_size()` **should** only ever be called from `Control::_update_minimum_size_cache()`... Every one of those unexpected calls is pure waste.
Way out of scope for this bugfix though.
